Emergencies

ईंधन क्रॉसफीड

A procedure that allows fuel to be transferred from one tank to another, typically to correct a fuel imbalance or supply an engine when a tank is low.

Quick answer: A procedure that allows fuel to be transferred from one tank to another, typically to correct a fuel imbalance or supply an engine when a tank is low.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A procedure that allows fuel to be transferred from one tank to another, typically to correct a fuel imbalance or supply an engine when a tank is low.

Operational example

Due to low fuel in the left tank, we are initiating crossfeed to the right engine.

Localized term

ईंधन क्रॉसफीड
